what: Plan threads the dispatcher pattern gate into panel dispatch, but panel row generation still reads original manifest output paths instead of the waterfall-resolved paths emitted in ALL_OUTPUT_FILES_PATH
scenario_or_breakage: Cursor narration-only OK can fail the new gate and Codex phase2 can write a valid -phase2 output, but the panel loop still greps the original cursor output path and records unparsed or missing; with broad phase1 mismatches PANEL_STATUS can become panel-failed despite successful fallbacks
suggested_fix: Read ALL_OUTPUT_FILES_PATH in manifest order before building panel-outputs.ndjson and use those final paths, ideally also threading ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS so vendor reflects the winning fallback tool; add a panel harness case where the paths file points at phase2 outputs
